**Drafted 4.2.0 into `CHANGELOG.md`.** Out of 380 commits, 37 touch users.

The headline is buried: an expired token now returns `401`, not `403`.

Two I could not settle from the log. Eight commits stop re-exporting error types. One drops a "v1 export route". Both break people if those were public.

I left the 10 speed-ups out. Your three headings have no home for them.
